JMResumeAWTContext

Starts the thread group associated with an AWT context. 
OSStatus JMResumeAWTContext (JMAWTContextRef context);
context
The AWT context whose thread you want to start.
function result
A result code. See "JManager Result Codes" (page 69) for a list of result codes that JManager may return in this field.
DISCUSSION
When you create an AWT context, the underlying thread group associated with it is in a suspended state. You must call JMResumeAWTContext to begin the thread before instantiating any applets or executing any calls through the Java Runtime Interface (JRI).

SEE ALSO
The AWTSuspendContext function (page 30).
